excerpts: # Ownership Learn how ownership works in Supabase Storage and how to control access When creating new buckets or objects in Supabase Storage, an owner is automatically assigned to the bucket or object. The owner is the user who created the resource and the value is derived from the `sub` claim in the JWT. We store the `owner` in the `owner_id` column. Note: When using the `service_key` to create a resource, the owner will not be set and the resourc

This is also the case when you are creating Storage resources via the Dashboard.
